releaseNotes:
• Icom IC-7300 & Yaesu Anti-Keying / USB Stability: Isolated DTR/RTS hardware lines so connecting the CAT COM port never keys PTT/CW on Yaesu FT-991A, FTDX10, or Icom IC-7300 rigs, plus continuous CI-V auto-baud wake-up preambles.
• Yaesu FT-991A, FTDX10, FTDX101MP & FTDX5000 Enhancements: Precision 9-digit/8-digit FA frequency commands, MD0 mode switching, and 1,200ms post-write poll hold.
• Live COM Port Hot-Plug Detection: Hardware Port dropdown dynamically rescans Windows COM ports when opened.
• UI & Settings Refinements: Aligned Quick Select Comment tags and streamlined Settings workflow.
